title: The Grain Office

victory.note: The Russians win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Germans win.

situation: A grain office and its yards at the edge of a burned town. The defenders hold the office block, and the attackers must take it before dark. The Russians attack with 5 squads under 2 leaders and 3 support weapons. The Germans hold with 4 squads under 1 leader. The Russians win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Germans win. The Russians move first. 5 turns.
notes: A project scenario of the library, slot L01 (owner directive, 2026-10-16), not a printed scenario. `sl-cli library` made it from draw seed 9 and board seed 10. The rule level is 21. The defending force is 247 points and the attacking force is 432 points on the scale of slcampaign.points, a share of 7 to 4. No part of it is card text (SR-07). Balance (gate item 4, 2026-10-17): v7 against v7 gave the Russian attacker 746 of 1,600 games (46.6 percent), artifact runs/20261017T011201Z-library-l01-s9, after the searches of draw seeds 1 to 10 and board seeds 1 to 20. Gate item 3: v3, v6, and v7 played it to the end on the two sides. The owner accepted the card on 2026-10-17. The card names the victory building by its rank and its band of columns since 2026-10-17, because nothing on the board marks a building; that change is to the text only.
